svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.21 MASONRY AND CONCRETE CHIMNEYS AND FLUES

g.text: Drip not less than 25 mm from the
Bond break between a cast-in-place cap
Cast-in-place concrete cap, cut in half
Joint in a precast or masonry cap
Flashing beneath the cap from the liner
Jointed precast concrete or masonry cap, cut in half

svg.text: The top of a chimney has a waterproof cap of
The cap slopes from the lining and is provided
with a drip not less than 25 mm (1″) from the
Cast-in-place concrete caps are separated from
the chimney liner by a bond break and are
Jointed precast concrete or masonry chimney
caps have flashing installed beneath the cap

Drawn: bond break, sealant and flashing thickness exaggerated. The Sentence (2) drip applies to B too, drawn in A only.
